headline: Grandad grabs the crown as Alex finishes with a flourish
text: Grandad and Argentina (Nana) shared a 0-0 in the final, so Grandad stay top dog overall and Nana keep the runners-up spot. The big shout from the recent results was England (Alex) beating France (Carolina) 6-4 for third place, then Alex earlier losing 2-1 to Argentina (Nana) in the semi-final. So Alex get a nice consolation, while Carolina take the knock. Overall, Grandad are best on 30 points, level with Max but ahead on goal difference. At the other end, Sofia are bottom on 10 points. A tidy little sweepstake kerfuffle, that.
